title_en: Subjective Meaning of Modal Verbs & Epistemic Modality

concepts.term_ar: الِاسْتِنْتَاجُ الْحَتْمِيُّ فِي الْحَاضِرِ (يَقِينٌ مُطْلَقٌ ~100%)
concepts.term_en: deductive certainty in the present (must be)
concepts.example_de: Das Licht brennt noch, der Professor muss noch im Institut sein.
concepts.example_ar: الضَّوْءُ لَا يَزَالُ مُشْتَعِلاً، لَا بُدَّ أَنَّ الأُسْتَاذَ لَا يَزَالُ فِي الْمَعْهَدِ.
concepts.example_en: The light is still on; the professor must still be at the institute.

concepts.term_ar: الِاسْتِنْتَاجُ الْقَاطِعُ عَنِ الْمَاضِي (لَا بُدَّ أَنَّهُ فَعَلَ كَذَا)
concepts.term_en: deductive certainty about the past (must have been)
concepts.example_de: Die Bremsspuren belegen: Das Fahrzeug muss viel zu schnell gefahren sein.
concepts.example_ar: تُثْبِتُ آثَارُ الْفَرَامِلِ: لَا بُدَّ أَنَّ الْمَرْكَبَةَ كَانَتْ تَسِيرُ بِسُرْعَةٍ فَائِقَةٍ.
concepts.example_en: The skid marks prove: The vehicle must have been driving far too fast.

concepts.term_ar: الِاسْتِحَالَةُ الْمَنْطِقِيَّةُ وَالنَّفْيُ الْقَاطِعُ (يَسْتَحِيلُ أَنْ يَكُونَ)
concepts.term_en: logical impossibility (cannot be / impossible)
concepts.example_de: Er hat ein wasserdichtes Alibi; er kann die Tat nicht begangen haben.
concepts.example_ar: لَدَيْهِ حُجَّةُ غِيَابٍ لَا غُبَارَ عَلَيْهَا؛ يَسْتَحِيلُ أَنْ يَكُونَ قَدِ ارْتَكَبَ الْجَرِيمَةَ.
concepts.example_en: He has an airtight alibi; he cannot have committed the crime.

concepts.term_ar: التَّوَقُّعُ الْمَنْطِقِيُّ شِبْهُ الْمُؤَكَّدِ (~90%)
concepts.term_en: high probability / expected outcome (should / ought to)
concepts.example_de: Wenn der Zug pünktlich war, müsste die Delegation jeden Moment eintreffen.
concepts.example_ar: إِذَا كَانَ الْقِطَارُ فِي مَوْعِدِهِ، فَيَنْبَغِي أَنْ يَصِلَ الْوَفْدُ فِي أَيَّةِ لَحْظَةٍ.
concepts.example_en: If the train was on time, the delegation ought to arrive any minute.

concepts.term_ar: التَّرْجِيحُ الْقَوِيُّ فِي الْحَاضِرِ (~75-80%)
concepts.term_en: strong probability (is likely to / probably is)
concepts.example_de: Die Renovierung dürfte bis zum Ende des Quartals abgeschlossen sein.
concepts.example_ar: مِنَ الْمُرَجَّحِ جِدًّا أَنْ تَنْتَهِيَ أَعْمَالُ التَّرْمِيمِ مَعَ نِهَايَةِ الرُّبْعِ السَّنَوِيِّ.
concepts.example_en: The renovation is likely to be completed by the end of the quarter.

concepts.term_de: dürfte + Infinitiv II (Wahrscheinlichkeit in der Vergangenheit)
concepts.term_ar: التَّرْجِيحُ الْقَوِيُّ لِحَدَثٍ فِي الْمَاضِي (يُرَجَّحُ أَنَّهُ حَدَثَ)
concepts.term_en: strong probability regarding the past (is likely to have)
concepts.example_de: Der Schaden dürfte durch das jüngste Unwetter entstanden sein.
concepts.example_ar: مِنَ الْمُرَجَّحِ أَنَّ الأَضْرَارَ نَجَمَتْ عَنِ الْعَاصِفَةِ الأَخِيرَةِ.
concepts.example_en: The damage is likely to have been caused by the recent storm.

concepts.term_ar: الإِمْكَانِيَّةُ الِاحْتِمَالِيَّةُ الْمُتَسَاوِيَةُ (~50%)
concepts.term_en: tentative possibility (could be / might be)
concepts.example_de: Die Preisschwankung könnte auf geopolitische Spannungen hindeuten.
concepts.example_ar: قَدْ يُشِيرُ تَذَبْذُبُ الأَسْعَارِ إِلَى تَبِعَاتِ التَّوَتُّرَاتِ الْجُيُوسِيَاسِيَّةِ.
concepts.example_en: The price fluctuation could indicate geopolitical tensions.

concepts.term_ar: الِاحْتِمَالُ فِي الْمَاضِي (قَدْ يَكُونُ حَدَثَ)
concepts.term_en: past possibility (could have happened / might have been)
concepts.example_de: Der Zeuge könnte sich im genauen Datum geirrt haben.
concepts.example_ar: قَدْ يَكُونُ الشَّاهِدُ قَدْ أَخْطَأَ فِي التَّارِيخِ الدَّقِيقِ.
concepts.example_en: The witness might have been mistaken about the exact date.

concepts.term_ar: الاحْتِمَالِيَّةُ الْمَفْتُوحَةُ وَعَدَمُ الْجَزْمِ (~50%)
concepts.term_en: open possibility (may / can well be)
concepts.example_de: Es kann durchaus sein, dass die Ergebnisse abweichen.
concepts.example_ar: مِنَ الْجَائِزِ تَمَامًا أَنْ تَكُونَ النَّتَائِجُ مُتَفَاوِتَةً.
concepts.example_en: It may well be that the results deviate.

concepts.term_ar: التَّسْلِيمُ الْجَدَلِيُّ وَالإِقْرَارُ مَعَ التَّحَفُّظِ (قَدْ يَكُونُ كَذَلِكَ، لَكِنْ)
concepts.term_en: concessive admission (may well be true, however...)
concepts.example_de: Das Argument mag zutreffen, dennoch rechtfertigt es kein Versäumnis.
concepts.example_ar: قَدْ يَكُونُ هَذَا الطَّرْحُ صَحِيحًا، غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَا يُبَرِّرُ أَيَّ تَقْصِيرٍ.
concepts.example_en: The argument may well apply, yet it does not justify any neglect.

concepts.term_ar: التَّسْلِيمُ بِحُدُوثِ أَمْرٍ فِي الْمَاضِي مَعَ مُعَارَضَةِ أَثَرِهِ
concepts.term_en: past concessive concession (may have been, but...)
concepts.example_de: Er mag früher Erfolge gefeiert haben, heute zählt nur die Gegenwart.
concepts.example_ar: قَدْ يَكُونُ حَقَّقَ نَجَاحَاتٍ فِي الْمَاضِي، لَكِنَّ الْعِبْرَةَ الْيَوْمَ بِالْحَاضِرِ.
concepts.example_en: He may have celebrated successes in the past, but today only the present counts.

concepts.term_ar: ادِّعَاءُ الْفَاعِلِ لِنَفْسِهِ دُونَ تَأْكِيدٍ مُسْتَقِلٍّ (يَدَّعِي أَنَّهُ)
concepts.term_en: subject's own claim / allegation (claims to be)
concepts.example_de: Der Verdächtige will von den Transaktionen nichts wissen.
concepts.example_ar: يَدَّعِي الْمُشْتَبَهُ فِيهِ أَنَّهُ لَا عِلْمَ لَهُ بِهَذِهِ الْمُعَامَلَاتِ.
concepts.example_en: The suspect claims to know nothing of the transactions.

concepts.term_de: wollen + Infinitiv II (Behauptung über die Vergangenheit)
concepts.term_ar: زَعْمُ الْفَاعِلِ بِأَنَّهُ قَامَ بِفِعْلٍ فِي الْمَاضِي (يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ فَعَلَ)
concepts.term_en: unverified claim about past action (claims to have done)
concepts.example_de: Er will das vertrauliche Dokument niemals gesehen haben.
concepts.example_ar: يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَرَ الْوَثِيقَةَ السِّرِّيَّةَ قَطُّ فِي حَيَاتِهِ.
concepts.example_en: He claims never to have seen the confidential document.

concepts.term_ar: نَقْلُ خَبَرٍ أَوْ شَائِعَةٍ عَنِ الْغَيْرِ دُونَ تَبَنِّيهِ (يُقَالُ إِنَّهُ)
concepts.term_en: reported speech / hearsay (is said to be / supposedly)
concepts.example_de: Der Vorstandsvorsitzende soll vor einem Rücktritt stehen.
concepts.example_ar: يُقَالُ إِنَّ رَئِيسَ مَجْلِسِ الإِدَارَةِ عَلَى وَشَكِ الاسْتِقَالَةِ.
concepts.example_en: The CEO is said to be on the verge of resigning.

concepts.term_ar: نَقْلُ أَقَاوِيلَ حَوْلَ وُقُوعِ أَمْرٍ فِي الْمَاضِي (يُشَاعُ أَنَّهُ حَدَثَ)
concepts.term_en: hearsay about past events (is alleged to have occurred)
concepts.example_de: Der Minister soll von den Unregelmäßigkeiten gewusst haben.
concepts.example_ar: يُشَاعُ أَنَّ الْوَزِيرَ كَانَ عَلَى عِلْمٍ بِالتَّجَاوُزَاتِ.
concepts.example_en: The minister is alleged to have known about the irregularities.

concepts.term_ar: الصِّيغَةُ الإِبِسْتِيمِيَّةُ (تَقْدِيرُ دَرَجَةِ صِدْقِيَّةِ الْمَعْرِفَةِ)
concepts.term_en: epistemic modality (assessment of truth commitment)
concepts.example_de: Epistemische Modalverben drücken den Grad der Gewissheit des Sprechers aus.
concepts.example_ar: تُعَبِّرُ أَدَوَاتُ التَّقْدِيرِ الإِبِسْتِيمِيَّةِ عَنْ دَرَجَةِ يَقِينِ الْمُتَكَلِّمِ.
concepts.example_en: Epistemic modal verbs express the speaker's degree of certainty.

concepts.term_ar: التَّنَصُّلُ الذَّاتِيُّ وَالتَّحَفُّظُ فِي نَقْلِ الْخَبَرِ
concepts.term_en: subjective distancing (critical linguistic neutrality)
concepts.example_de: Durch das Verb 'sollen' wahrt der Journalist journalistische Distanz.
concepts.example_ar: يَحْفَظُ الصَّحَفِيُّ حِيَادَهُ الْمِهْنِيَّ عَبْرَ اسْتِخْدَامِ الفِعْلِ 'sollen'.
concepts.example_en: Through the verb 'sollen', the journalist maintains professional distance.

concepts.term_ar: دَعْوَى الصِّحَّةِ وَالْمَطْلَبُ الْحَقِيقِيُّ لِلْحُجَّةِ
concepts.term_en: claim to truth / validity claim
concepts.example_de: Jede wissenschaftliche These erhebt einen überprüfbaren Wahrheitsanspruch.
concepts.example_ar: تَرْفَعُ كُلُّ أُطْرُوحَةٍ عِلْمِيَّةٍ دَعْوَى صِحَّةٍ قَابِلَةٍ لِلتَّدْقِيقِ.
concepts.example_en: Every scientific thesis raises a verifiable claim to truth.

concepts.term_ar: تَدَرُّجُ مَرَاتِبِ الظَّنِّ وَالتَّخْمِينِ (مِنَ الشَّكِّ إِلَى الْقَطْعِ)
concepts.term_en: scale of probability / gradation of conjecture
concepts.example_de: Die deutsche Grammatik verfügt über eine präzise Vermutungsabstufung.
concepts.example_ar: تَمْتَلِكُ قَوَاعِدُ اللُّغَةِ الأَلْمَانِيَّةِ سُلَّمًا دَقِيقًا لِتَدَرُّجِ مَرَاتِبِ التَّخْمِينِ.
concepts.example_en: German grammar possesses a precise gradation of conjecture.

concepts.term_ar: الْقَوْلُ الْمَنْقُولُ عَنِ الْغَيْرِ دُونَ تَبَنٍّ
concepts.term_en: third-party statement / indirect attribution
concepts.example_de: Im juristischen Diskurs müssen Fremdaussagen klar gekennzeichnet werden.
concepts.example_ar: يَجِبُ تَمْيِيزُ الأَقْوَالِ الْمَنْقُولَةِ عَنِ الْغَيْرِ بِوُضُوحٍ فِي الْخِطَابِ الْقَانُونِيِّ.
concepts.example_en: In legal discourse, third-party statements must be clearly marked.

concepts.term_ar: إِبْدَاءُ الرَّيْبَةِ وَالتَّشْكِيكِ النَّقْدِيِّ
concepts.term_en: expression of skepticism / critical doubt
concepts.example_de: Die Formulierung ist eine feine Skepsisbekundung des Autors.
concepts.example_ar: تُمَثِّلُ الصِّيَاغَةُ إِبْدَاءً دَقِيقًا لِرَيْبَةِ الْمُؤَلِّفِ وَشَكِّهِ.
concepts.example_en: The formulation is a subtle expression of the author's skepticism.

concepts.term_ar: إِسْنَادُ الْمَعْلُومَةِ إِلَى مَصْدَرِهَا الْخَارِجِيِّ
concepts.term_en: source attribution / referential citing
concepts.example_de: Eine exakte Quellenzuschreibung schützt vor Vorwürfen der Fälschung.
concepts.example_ar: يَحْمِي الإِسْنَادُ الدَّقِيقُ لِلْمَصَادِرِ مِنِ اتِّهَامَاتِ التَّزْيِيفِ.
concepts.example_en: Exact source attribution protects against accusations of fabrication.

concepts.term_ar: إِعَادَةُ بِنَاءِ الْوَقَائِعِ فَرَضِيًّا وَاسْتِدْلَالِيًّا
concepts.term_en: hypothetical reconstruction of past events
concepts.example_de: Die Kriminalisten arbeiten an der hypothetischen Rekonstruktion der Tat.
concepts.example_ar: يَعْمَلُ خُبَرَاءُ الأَدِلَّةِ الْجِنَائِيَّةِ عَلَى إِعَادَةِ بِنَاءِ الْجَرِيمَةِ فَرَضِيًّا.
concepts.example_en: Forensic experts work on the hypothetical reconstruction of the crime.

concepts.term_ar: مُرَكَّبُ أَدَوَاتِ التَّسْلِيمِ وَالتَّرْخِيصِ (mag zwar... aber)
concepts.term_en: concessive particle complex
concepts.example_de: Der Satz verbindet 'mag' und 'zwar' zu einem eleganten Zugeständnis.
concepts.example_ar: تَرْبِطُ الْجُمْلَةُ بَيْنَ 'mag' وَ 'zwar' لِصِيَاغَةِ تَسْلِيمٍ جَدَلِيٍّ أَنِيقٍ.
concepts.example_en: The sentence combines 'mag' and 'zwar' into an elegant concession.

concepts.term_ar: الْبَيَانِيَّةُ وَالدَّلَالِيَّةُ الإِثْبَاتِيَّةُ لِمَصْدَرِ الْخَبَرِ
concepts.term_en: evidentiality (linguistic coding of information source)
concepts.example_de: Evidentialität zeigt an, ob Information aus eigener Anschauung stammt.
concepts.example_ar: تُبَيِّنُ الدَّلَالِيَّةُ الإِثْبَاتِيَّةُ مَا إِذَا كَانَتِ الْمَعْلُومَةُ نَابِعَةً مِنْ مُعَايَنَةٍ شَخْصِيَّةٍ.
concepts.example_en: Evidentiality indicates whether information stems from direct observation.
